figurative_meaning_bn: কৌলিন্যের জন্য 'পণ্ডিত' উপাধি ধারণকারী মূর্খ ব্যক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: A foolish person who holds the title of 'pandit' due to family lineage rather than knowledge
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে না পড়ে পণ্ডিত, শুধু জাতের জন্য নামটা পেয়েছে।
এই না পড়ে পণ্ডিতরা সবসময় ভুল করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a pandit without reading; he got the title just from his family.
These scholars without study always make mistakes due to their ignorance.
history: In Western Bengal, the title 'Pandit' is traditionally given to all Brahmins by lineage, regardless of scholarly achievement.
note: The idiom critiques the assumption of knowledge based on hereditary titles in Bengali society.
